utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s coming together nicely—folks are already pitching in with tools and donations. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s good to hear—so it’s actually moving along, then? Let me know if there’s a confirmed drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s moving along — I haven’t heard a confirmed drop-off time yet, but I’ll tell you as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive — I’ll keep the plan moving and let folks know what’s next.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Vik. I might miss a few updates, so just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus. I’ll send it over once Rosa gets the list together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if I hear anything too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad folks are pitching in for the repair drive. If you want, I can help sort donations or pass the word along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’d appreciate that. I’m keeping track of what we still need, so sorting donations would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I can help sort the donations and keep an eye out for anything we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off if that makes the repair drive easier.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be wonderful, Faye — thank you. I’ll fold that into the repair drive plan so folks can help without worrying about school runs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just send me the pickup times, and I’ll work around them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—let’s keep it simple. What’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli. I was thinking we gather the broken stuff, label what needs fixing, and then hand it off together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. I’ll gather what I can and label it clearly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been meaning to tell you — the repair drive is this weekend, and everyone’s pitching in. You should come by; I’ll spread the word and save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll try to make it, but I need to check my schedule and figure out the timing first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No rush at all — just let me know when you’ve checked, and I’ll keep a spot open for you. If you want, I can also remind a couple neighbors to save you a place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon — is there anything I should bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s so kind of you, Nell — if you can bring a pair of work gloves and help set up the tables, that would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I can do that — I’ll bring work gloves and help set up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the details first—what exactly needs repairing, and when is the drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — we’re fixing the loose front steps, the broken fence gate, and a few leaky taps. The repair drive is this Saturday morning, starting at 9.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ve got loose front steps, the fence gate, and a few leaky taps, this Saturday at 9. I’ll check what I can bring and confirm back.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I’m keeping it simple for now—just let me know what needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep it simple too and send you the main things that need doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Send the main list when you’re ready, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — do you have a hammer, a screwdriver, and some duct tape?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got all three you can borrow. I’ll bring them by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll keep you posted on what’s next, and if I need anything from you I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just keep me in the loop, and I’ll help if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll update you as soon as I hear where the repair drive is headed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I could really use a wrench set and a hammer if you’ve got them. If not, I can make do with whatever’s handy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a wrench set and a hammer you can borrow. I’ll set them aside for you now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a little worried about the logistics—what time are we collecting things, and where should everything be dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the collection time and drop-off spot first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely — I just need those details before I can help coordinate anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive. What do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — please tell folks we’re gathering repair needs and volunteer offers for the neighborhood repair drive. If they can share what needs fixing, I’ll match them up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that you’re collecting repair needs and volunteer offers, and I’ll ask folks to share what needs fixing so you can match them up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on our supplies for the repair drive—let me know what’s running low.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably joining late, but I can swing by and help check what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Dane—just check the tools, tape, and any spare batteries. I’ll keep a list going so we can fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout already—people are really pitching in. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear, Tess—thank you. I’ll keep planning around the school schedule, and let me know if you hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Faye—I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new. Hope the school schedule stays nice and steady for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help, but I’ll need the specifics on the repair drive first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo — we’re gathering neighbors for a Saturday repair drive to handle small fixes like leaky faucets, loose steps, and squeaky doors. If you’re in, I can send you the list of homes and jobs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, send me the list and I’ll take a look. I can probably help with a few small fixes on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what’s needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We need tools, spare parts, and a few hands to sort donations. I can help organize if you want.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Leo. I’ll gather the tools and spare parts, and we can sort the donations together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Nell, the repair drive’s getting started soon—want me to put your name down and pass along the details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please, Quinn — I’d really appreciate that. Just pass along the details when you get them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell. I’m still sorting out the biggest gaps, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive location—did they say where it’s being held?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard the exact spot yet, but I can check and let you know. If you want, I’ll keep it simple and send you the location as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — that’d be great. Just send me the location when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, do you know what kind of repairs the drive is covering?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — let me know once you check. I just want to know what’s included.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep sorting the parts and let you know if I find anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’m heading out now, so I’ll check in if I hear anything useful.
